svg.text: A chain down the page: Feynman moves from spotting unscientific beliefs, to naming the failure as 'Cargo Cult
Science', to the principle of integrity that cures it, to examples of scientists fooling themselves, to case
studies proving the point, ending on a final wish — each part building on the last.

g.text: A single chain: pseudoscience observed, named, diagnosed, and then illustrated with cases, ending in a wish.
